title: Project 2 · Find the best sellers
prompt: From order_items, return product_id, units (the total quantity ordered) and lines (the number of order items) for every product with at least 16 units. Put the most units first, and sort products with the same units by product_id.
hints: One row per product, then keep only some of those rows.
The test on the total comes after GROUP BY, in HAVING.
GROUP BY product_id HAVING sum(quantity) >= 16 ORDER BY units DESC, product_id

wrongAnswers.misconception: Leaves out a product with exactly 16 units.
Applies the limit to the number of order items instead of the units.

feedback: Add up one product's quantities by hand in schema.sql and compare with your units.
